title.narrative: Promoting and upscaling innovative SMEs in the Islamic Republic of Iran

description.narrative: The project proposal refers to the letter of Mr Azari Jahromi, Minister of Information and Communication Technology of Iran dated 20 January 2019, requesting UNIDO to support the Government of Iran in advancing sustainable industrial development through formulation and implementation of a technical cooperation project focusing on improving competitiveness of ICT start-ups and SMEs in Iran. As a response, UNIDO proposed a technical cooperation project aimed to contribute to the economic growth and diversification as well as export and employment creation and facilitate regional socio-economic, industrial and trade integration of Iran through strengthening national technical capacities and improvement of competitiveness of ICT start-ups and SMEs in Iran.
